104 × 88 metres · Street, bowl and transition · RIFT board

Quest — left stick: up pushes, down brakes, sideways steers. Balance grinds and manuals with your hands: right hand up pushes the meter right, left hand up pushes it left.
Right A: hold to crouch, release to ollie. Right trigger: press once to grind (a rail or coping only catches if you pressed it just before touching it; Right A hops you off). Right B in the air, then stick left: kickflip, stick right: heelflip (start it early, finish it before you land). Quick up-down flick of the left stick: manual (flick in the air after an ollie to land in one). On a rail, stick up: nosegrind, stick down: 5-0. Left Y: switch stance. Hold both grips: stand on the board where you are. Hold left X: back to the entrance.
